rules.text: Voice is friendly, clear and confident. Avoid hype and exaggeration.
rules.suggestion: Replace hype with a specific, verifiable benefit.

rules.text: Never make absolute or guaranteed claims about results, savings or security.
rules.suggestion: Use qualified language such as 'helps reduce' or 'designed to'.

rules.text: Do not name or disparage competitors.
rules.suggestion: Remove the competitor reference and describe Brightly's own strengths.

rules.text: Use plain words. Avoid jargon such as 'synergy', 'leverage' or 'paradigm'.
rules.suggestion: Use simpler wording, e.g. 'use' instead of 'leverage'.

rules.text: No ALL CAPS words and at most one exclamation mark per piece.
rules.suggestion: Use sentence case and keep exclamation marks to a minimum.

rules.text: The product is always written 'Brightly' (capital B, one word).

facts.text: The Pro plan costs $12 per user per month.
